title: WCLI-116 follow-up: make the audit-empty assertion fire first and read the control through printedOf
description: Reviewer fix (a) from the confirmatory review of ward-cli#218 at d4df4183c, split out by the opum-doc ruling under DEC-172 (4ab) (opum-ai/opum-doc#1528, ODOC-552) so it is not a gate on #218. In test/refused-header-cli.test.ts the case "a refused run of an approved profile persists nothing" cannot fail on its empty-audit assertion: with the refusal deleted, run stops at profile_approval_stale (run.ts:161-162) before writeAudit (run.ts:399), so the suffix assertion is the only thing that fails. Make the empty-history assertion the one that can fire, for example by driving a profile that reaches admission when the refusal is removed, and read the "admitted run writes an audit event" control through printedOf. Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A mutation that removes only the header refusal turns the empty-audit assertion red in the case that asserts it
The admitted-run control reads its output through printedOf
